title: Welcome
text: 👑 Welcome to Alux Art Academy! Your daily spot for short, simple lessons on turning everyday selfies into stunning professional photos with Alux Art. One quick gem every morning. 💎 📲 Step one: install the app on your phone So Alux Art opens like a real app, add it to your home screen: 1️⃣ Open www.aluxartandframes.shop in your browser 2️⃣ Tap the Share icon — the little box with an arrow pointing up ⬆️ 3️⃣ Scroll down the menu that opens 4️⃣ Tap 'Add to Home Screen' Done! The Alux Art icon now sits on your phone like any other app — one tap to start your shoots. 🚀 On Android? Tap your browser's ⋮ menu, then 'Add to Home screen' or 'Install app'. Not signed up yet? Do it today 👉 www.aluxartandframes.shop

title: What is Alux Art
text: 📸 What exactly is Alux Art? Simple: you pick a photographer's style, upload a few selfies, and our AI creates professional photos of YOU in that exact style. No studio. No appointment. No expensive shoot. Your face, their vision — ready in minutes. Start here 👉 www.aluxartandframes.shop

title: Browse the marketplace
text: 🛍️ Lesson: Finding your perfect look Open the Marketplace and you'll see styles from Nigeria's best photographers — Portrait, Corporate, Wedding, Trending looks and more. Tap a category at the top to filter, or use the search bar to find a vibe. See one you love? Tap it to open the full style. 👇

title: Uploading your photos
text: 🤳 Lesson: Your uploads matter MOST The AI learns your face from the selfies you upload. Better selfies = better results. ✅ Clear, well-lit face ✅ A few different angles ✅ No sunglasses, no heavy filters ❌ Blurry or dark photos ❌ Group photos Give the AI good material and it rewards you. 🔥

title: Choosing your package
text: 📦 Lesson: Picking your package Most styles let you choose how many images you want — usually 1, 5, or 10. • Just need one clean shot? Grab the single. • Want a full set for your feed? The 5 or 10 pack gives variety — different poses and angles. More images = more looks to post all week. 📅

title: After you order
text: ⏳ Lesson: After you place your order Once you pay, the AI gets to work creating your photos one by one. You'll watch them appear as each finishes. If one image doesn't come out right, you can retry just that image — no stress. When they're ready, download them straight to your phone. 📲

title: Look natural, not AI
text: 💎 Gem of the day: Look natural, not 'AI' Want results people can't tell are AI? Three secrets: 1️⃣ Upload sharp, high-quality selfies 2️⃣ Include a couple of neutral (non-smiling) shots AND one smiling 3️⃣ Pick a style that matches your real vibe The better your inputs, the more the output looks like the real, premium you. 👑
